description: Brisca is the Spanish counterpart of Italian Briscolaâ€”a point-trick game played with the 40-card Spanish deck without suit-following obligation. Card ranking: Ace (11pts) > 3 (10pts) > King (4pts) > Queen (3pts) > Jack (2pts) > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 2 (0pts). The trump suit is determined by a face-up card beside the stock pile. Each trick won adds to the player's score pile; the winner is first to 61 points.

Brisca is the Spanish adaptation of the Italian Briscola, sharing the same unusual card ranking (Ace > Three > picture cards). It spread throughout the Iberian Peninsula and Latin America.

items.text: Brisca 4 Players (Partnership): 2v2 with partners sitting opposite. Play all 40 cards across 10 tricks (no draw). Silent communication through plays.
